proposedBellaRules.scope: Kind only inside an already-read supported OMF. Existing release-one version/identity/text decisions, MDB six-class lookup and Bin Filter unchanged. Native WAV/AIFF precedence, final source priorities and header opening remain separate.

Preserve inventory and independent valid metadata; unrelated damaged numeric/codec fields do not erase a known independently valid class. proposedBellaRules.representation: Four-byte structured class tags need no UTF8/MacRoman conversion. One small fixed C++17 helper returns a strongly typed Audio/Video/Unknown value. Generate display text as needed; no per-row duplicate class string or hierarchy solely for Kind.
proposedBellaRules.reading: Do not read codec/summary/recording data or master track graph merely to confirm a known own descriptor. No extra file open approved here.
proposedBellaRules.noScopeExpansion: No generic DIDD or new aliases added merely from native inheritance. Preserve current JPED/TIFD OMF coverage rather than narrowing to MDB list.
proposedBellaRules.engineeringAssessment: Current Kind already uses a small lookup. No demonstrated Kind-specific speed or accuracy improvement. Whole Bella design requires required-output, scan-time and peak-memory comparisons after implementation.
